related_work:
1. A Bicycle Built for Two Thousand (2009) by Aaron Koblin and Darren Massey

2. The HAL 9000 scene from Stanley Kubrick's *2001: A Space Odyssey* (1968)
conclusion_future_work: These works made me realise that technology is more than a tool. I want to explore how it influences our perception of what is human.
results_discussion: What surprised me was the contrast between the two works. HAL is a computer, but its singing makes it seem almost human. In contrast, *A Bicycle Built for Two Thousand* combines thousands of human voices, creating something strangely mechanical.This made me question whether technology can change how we recognise human emotions.
title: week 1
introduction: We explored the relationship between art and technology. After watching two artworks, I became interested in how technology can change our perception of humans and machines.
